capability.summary: Measure area or distance, test the intersects predicate, or return a WKT centroid
capability.description: Parses a primary WKT geometry; operation area returns its area, intersects tests the intersects predicate against a second WKT, distance measures to a second WKT, and every other operation value returns the centroid. Direct wrapper invocation defaults an omitted third argument to area, and every result is converted to a string.
capability.problem_space: Small planar geometry calculations over one or two WKT-encoded Shapely geometries.

constraint.io_signature: Inputs: primary WKT, optional secondary WKT, and operation; output: JSON echoing operation with result always serialized as a string.
accepted_inputs: a valid WKT geometry for area or centroid calculation
two valid WKT geometries for intersects or distance operations
operation area, intersects, or distance; an omitted operation defaults to area in direct wrapper invocation, while any other value selects centroid
constraint.output_shape: Success is an object with status="success", tool="lib.shapely_geometry", operation as the selected or defaulted operation string, and result as a string containing the area number, intersects predicate True/False, distance number, or centroid representation. A caught WKT-parse, missing-secondary-geometry, topology, or geometry-operation exception produces an object with status="error", tool="lib.shapely_geometry", and message as the exception string, then exits with code 1.
limitations: supports exact operations area, intersects, and distance; every unknown operation string silently computes the primary geometry centroid
direct wrapper invocation defaults an omitted third operation argument to area even though the manifest input contract retains required=true
requires wkt_b only for intersects and distance and ignores it for area and centroid
stringifies every result, so numeric values and booleans are not returned with native JSON types
uses Shapely's planar Cartesian calculations with no CRS metadata, geodesic distance, or coordinate transformation
invalid WKT, missing secondary geometry for binary operations, and topology errors use the wrapper's error envelope

output_contract.description: Echoed operation and a stringified area, intersection verdict, distance, or centroid result.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.

intent_tags: calculate WKT area distance or centroid
test whether two WKT geometries intersect
negative_intents: compute geometry union intersection shapes or buffers
return numeric or boolean results with native JSON types
